constraints.name: operators_name_check
constraints.definition: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 120 AND char_length(initials) BETWEEN 1 AND 4

constraints.name: auth_sessions_active_device_idx
constraints.definition: (device_id) WHERE ended_at IS NULL AND device_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: auth_sessions_biometric_device_check
constraints.definition: method <> 'BIOMETRIC' OR device_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: auth_sessions_times_check
constraints.definition: last_seen_at >= issued_at AND absolute_expires_at > issued_at AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: auth_sessions_end_reason_check
constraints.definition: end_reason IS NULL OR end_reason IN ('SIGNED_OUT', 'IDLE_EXPIRED', 'ABSOLUTE_EXPIRED', 'ROTATED', 'USER_DISABLED', 'DEVICE_REVOKED', 'DEVICE_UNPAIRED', 'TOKEN_REUSE')

constraints.name: auth_sessions_token_reuse_check
constraints.definition: end_reason IS DISTINCT FROM 'TOKEN_REUSE' OR method = 'BIOMETRIC'

constraints.name: pairing_codes_times_check
constraints.definition: expires_at > issued_at AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: pairing_codes_closed_check
constraints.definition: (state = 'ACTIVE') = (closed_at IS NULL) AND (closed_by_operator_id IS NULL OR state = 'CANCELLED')

constraints.name: paired_devices_text_check
constraints.definition: char_length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 60 AND char_length(platform) BETWEEN 1 AND 32 AND char_length(app_version) BETWEEN 1 AND 32

constraints.name: paired_devices_lifecycle_check
constraints.definition: (state = 'PAIRED' AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NULL AND revoke_reason IS NULL AND unpaired_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'REVOKED' AND revoked_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NOT NULL AND char_length(revoke_reason) BETWEEN 5 AND 500 AND unpaired_at IS NULL) OR (state = 'UNPAIRED' AND unpaired_at IS NOT NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND revoked_by_operator_id IS NULL AND revoke_reason IS NULL)

constraints.name: device_credentials_lengths_check
constraints.definition: octet_length(current_hash) = 32 AND (next_hash IS NULL OR (octet_length(next_hash) = 32 AND next_hash <> current_hash))

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_one_live_key
constraints.definition: (device_id, operator_id) WHERE used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_live_operator_idx
constraints.definition: (operator_id) WHERE used_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_times_check
constraints.definition: expires_at > issued_at AND (used_at IS NULL OR used_at >= issued_at)

constraints.name: biometric_tokens_revoke_check
constraints.definition: (revoked_at IS NULL) = (revoke_reason IS NULL) AND (revoke_reason IS NULL OR revoke_reason IN ('DISABLED', 'REENROLLED', 'TOKEN_REUSE', 'DEVICE_REVOKED', 'DEVICE_UNPAIRED', 'USER_DISABLED'))

constraints.name: audit_log_actor_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (actor_id, seq) WHERE actor_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: audit_log_session_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (session_id, seq) WHERE session_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: audit_log_evidence_id_seq_idx
constraints.definition: (evidence_id, seq) WHERE evidence_id IS NOT NULL

constraints.name: active_session_time_source_check
constraints.definition: (start_time_source IS NULL OR start_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND (stop_time_source IS NULL OR stop_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: active_session_json_check
constraints.definition: jsonb_typeof(precheck) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(finalization) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(timeline) = 'array' AND jsonb_array_length(timeline) <= 200 AND jsonb_typeof(notes) = 'array' AND (fault IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(fault) = 'object') AND (recovery IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(recovery) = 'object')

constraints.name: session_history_outcome_check
constraints.definition: outcome IN ('SEALED', 'INCOMPLETE') AND (fault_kind IS NULL OR (outcome = 'INCOMPLETE' AND fault_kind IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER')))

constraints.name: session_history_values_check
constraints.definition: duration_ms >= 0 AND size_bytes >= 0 AND ended_at >= created_at

constraints.name: session_history_time_source_check
constraints.definition: (start_time_source IS NULL OR start_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND (end_time_source IS NULL OR end_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: evidence_items_input_check
constraints.definition: subject_type IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA') AND profile_id IN ('STANDARD_1080P25') AND (case_type IS NULL OR case_type IN ('TERSANGKA', 'SAKSI', 'LAINNYA'))

constraints.name: evidence_items_tamper_check
constraints.definition: tampered_track_id IS NULL OR tampered_track_id IN ('VIDEO-01', 'VIDEO-02', 'AUDIO-01', 'AUDIO-02')

constraints.name: evidence_items_values_check
constraints.definition: duration_ms >= 0 AND size_bytes >= 0 AND ended_at >= recorded_at AND (sealed_at IS NULL OR sealed_at >= ended_at)

constraints.name: evidence_items_sources_check
constraints.definition: (integrity_source IS NULL OR integrity_source IN ('DEMO_PACKAGE', 'SIMULATED')) AND (start_time_source IS NULL OR start_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC')) AND (end_time_source IS NULL OR end_time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC'))

constraints.name: evidence_tracks_track_check
constraints.definition: track_id IN ('VIDEO-01', 'VIDEO-02', 'AUDIO-01', 'AUDIO-02') AND position BETWEEN 1 AND 4

constraints.name: exports_scope_check
constraints.definition: scope IN ('EVIDENCE', 'AUDIT', 'LOGS') AND ((scope = 'EVIDENCE') = (evidence_id IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: alerts_kind_check
constraints.definition: severity IN ('INFO', 'SUCCESS', 'WARNING', 'CRITICAL') AND (kind = 'SYSTEM' OR kind IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER'))

constraints.name: storage_policy_values_check
constraints.definition: retention_policy IN ('DAYS_30', 'DAYS_90', 'YEAR_1', 'CASE_CLOSURE') AND retention_days BETWEEN 1 AND 3650

constraints.name: core_state_values_check
constraints.definition: scenario IN ('idle', 'recording', 'finalizing', 'fault-demo') AND epoch >= 0 AND sim_schema_version >= 1

constraints.name: hardware_snapshot_shapes_check
constraints.definition: jsonb_typeof(cameras) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(mics) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(services) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(other_devices) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(ports) = 'array' AND jsonb_typeof(tablet_link) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(storage) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(time_status) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(network) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(security) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(health) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(faults) = 'object' AND jsonb_typeof(software_update) = 'object' AND (diagnostics IS NULL OR jsonb_typeof(diagnostics) = 'object')

constraints.name: health_snapshots_cause_check
constraints.definition: cause IN ('INTERVAL', 'FAULT_RAISED', 'FAULT_CLEARED') AND ((cause = 'INTERVAL') = (fault_kind IS NULL)) AND (fault_kind IS NULL OR fault_kind IN ('CAMERA_LOSS', 'MIC_NO_SIGNAL', 'MIC_CLIP', 'STORAGE_LOW', 'STORAGE_FULL', 'GNSS_LOSS', 'TAMPER', 'FAN_STALL', 'POWER_FAIL', 'TPM_FAILURE', 'SECURITY_FAULT', 'AUDIT_TAMPER'))

constraints.name: health_snapshots_states_check
constraints.definition: storage_state IN ('READY', 'LOW', 'FULL') AND time_source IN ('GNSS', 'NTP', 'RTC') AND security_state IN ('READY', 'FAULT') AND (session_state IS NULL OR session_state IN ('CREATE', 'PRECHECK', 'ARMED', 'RECORDING', 'STOPPING', 'FINALIZING', 'SEALED', 'FAULT', 'RECOVERY')) AND active_faults >= 0

constraints.name: audit_chain_history_values_check
constraints.definition: row_count >= 1 AND first_seq >= 1 AND last_seq >= first_seq
